The data that is being used was derived from the [TidyTuesday repository](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2023/2023-02-14). The data set for this week comes from [Hollywood Age Gap](https://hollywoodagegap.com/) and [Data Is Plural](https://www.data-is-plural.com/archive/2018-02-07-edition/). 

### Data Manipulation
These are the libraries we will be using:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```
The data was downloaded from the TidyTuesday repository and is referenced here as `age_gaps.csv`. 
```{r}
df <- read.csv("age_gaps.csv")
```
### Data Visualization

We will make a histogram of the age differences of various movie couples.
```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = age_difference)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, color = "black", fill="pink") +
  labs(title = "Varying Age Differences in Famous Movie Couples",
       x = "Age Difference (years)", y = "Couples")+
  theme_minimal()
```
